actionConfiguration.body:
WITH RECURSIVE department_tree AS (
      -- 루트 부서 (parent_id가 NULL인 최상위 부서)
      SELECT
          id,
          name,
          code,
          alias,
          parent_id,
          sort_order,
          status,
          1 AS depth,
          ARRAY[id]::VARCHAR[] AS path,  -- 타입 캐스팅 추가
          LPAD(sort_order::text, 5, '0') AS sort_path
      FROM public.department
      WHERE parent_id IS NULL
        AND deleted_at IS NULL

      UNION ALL

      -- 하위 부서들 재귀적으로 조회
      SELECT
          d.id,
          d.name,
          d.code,
          d.alias,
          d.parent_id,
          d.sort_order,
          d.status,
          dt.depth + 1,
          dt.path || d.id,
          dt.sort_path || '-' || LPAD(d.sort_order::text, 5, '0')
      FROM public.department d
      INNER JOIN department_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id
      WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL
  )
  SELECT
      dt.id AS department_id,
      dt.name AS department_name,
      dt.code AS department_code,
      dt.parent_id,
      dt.depth,
      dt.path AS department_path_ids,
      dt.sort_path,
      m.id AS member_id,
      m.user_id,
      m.member_type,
      m.duty_code_id,
      m.department_order,
      m.sort_order AS member_sort_order,
      u.name AS member_name,
      u.employee_number,
      u.mobile_number,
      u.profile_image_path
  FROM department_tree dt
  LEFT JOIN public.member m ON m.department_id = dt.id
  LEFT JOIN public.user u ON m.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY dt.sort_path, m.department_order, m.sort_order;
